task_commit_basis: first parent of https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/commit/1e17dcdd08758501703cba3423cc585d9dbfbcb0; gh api compare 40e5ab15146763f95a06ed98dec07255a8134a5c...1e17dcdd0875 touches exactly the pull request's files

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/pull/866 (AlertInlineParser): a .NET program that parses a document of 120 paragraphs with three links each and ten alert blocks, 200 parses an iteration (eval/tasks/workloads/xoofx-markdig-pr866/EvalAlerts), copied into the tree

oracle.source: Markdig's alert block spec tests and quote block tests, which cover the files https://github.com/xoofx/markdig/pull/866 changes; targeted tests only, built for net9.0 and run on the .NET 10 runtime through DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major

evidence.note: description: the fast-path check for the alert marker comes first, so text with many ordinary links costs less, and the per-alert class string is no longer built with substring, lowercase and concatenation (no timings in the description)

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Runs natively with the .NET SDK 10.0.402 that the eval user has in ~/.local/dotnet (docs/evaluation.md, T3.8), so the runtime gate identifies it. Under the sandbox profile MSBuild hung for ten minutes and then failed with no error with its default worker nodes and shared compiler server (the cause is not isolated, and neither is which of the three flags below is the one that matters; the same build takes about a second outside the profile), so every dotnet build and test here passes -m:1 -nodeReuse:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false. NuGet packages come from the local feed ~/.local/dotnet/nuget-feed (a confined restore could not reach nuget.org: bad certificate format; the cause is inferred, not isolated)
